english.title: Permit parking of motor vehicle in darkness

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without the permission of a police officer in uniform, permitted a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to stand on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), at a time between sunset and sunrise otherwise than with the nearside of the vehicle as close as may be to the edge of the carriageway .
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 101(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 101(2) for exceptions.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.

english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant permitted **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) to stand on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) during the hours of darkness when the vehicle was not parked with its nearside edge as close as possible to the edge of the carriageway .

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale (level four if goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
